meta.title: Awesome WebGPU Components
meta.tagline: Curated, link-verified building blocks for the WebGPU era: engines, toolkits, framework components and devtools.
meta.intro: WebGPU has quietly crossed from 'upcoming API' to the default rendering backend of the modern web: three.js and Babylon.js ship production WebGPU renderers, Rust's wgpu implements the spec natively, and a new generation of component libraries — shader effects you drop into React or Svelte, UI kits rendered inside 3D scenes, GPU charting — is being built on top. This list indexes those building blocks. Every link is checked to be live when this README is regenerated.
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public sources — no independent testing of the linked projects.

sections.title: Engines and Renderers with WebGPU Backends
sections.description: Full rendering engines where WebGPU is either the native foundation or a production backend.

items.name: three.js
items.what: JavaScript 3D library whose renderer supports the WebGPU backend alongside WebGL.

items.name: Babylon.js
items.what: Open game and rendering engine with a WebGPU engine backend and a node-based scene model.

items.name: engine (PlayCanvas)
items.what: Web graphics runtime built on WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR and glTF for interactive 3D apps.

items.name: Orillusion
items.what: Pure Web3D rendering engine built entirely on WebGPU with a component-based ECS design.

items.name: spark
items.what: Advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting renderer for three.js, WebGPU-first.

items.name: maplibre-rs
items.what: Rust-based WebGPU map renderer for Web, Mobile and Desktop.

items.name: spektral
items.what: Minimalist framework for modern WebGPU visuals.

items.name: burrow
items.what: Toy WebGPU deferred renderer demonstrating a practical rendering architecture.

sections.title: Low-Level Toolkits and GPU Utilities
sections.description: Implementations, wrappers and shader libraries one level below the frameworks.

items.name: wgpu
items.what: Cross-platform, safe, pure-Rust graphics API implementing the WebGPU spec for native and web.

items.name: wgpu-native
items.what: Native WebGPU implementation based on wgpu-core, exposing WebGPU as a C library.

items.name: gpu.cpp
items.what: A lightweight library for portable low-level GPU computation using WebGPU compute shaders.

items.name: TypeGPU
items.what: Modular toolkit for WebGPU with advanced type inference for writing shaders in TypeScript.

items.name: vgpu
items.what: Modular cross-runtime WebGPU library for shaders, 3D scenes, GPU tensors and math.

items.name: webgpu-utils
items.what: Helpers for WebGPU covering pipeline setup, resources and common boilerplate.

items.name: lygia
items.what: Granular multi-language shader library including WGSL for WebGPU pipelines.

items.name: pristine-grid-webgpu
items.what: A WebGPU implementation of the Pristine Grid shader technique.

items.name: webgpu-bundle-culling
items.what: WebGPU demonstration of frustum culling with render bundles through indirect instructions.

items.name: watlas
items.what: Web port of XAtlas: mesh parameterization and UV unwrapping usable in WebGPU pipelines.

sections.title: Framework Components
sections.description: Drop-in components and bindings for React, React Native, react-three-fiber and friends.

items.name: shaders (shader-effects-inc)
items.what: WebGPU shader-effect components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, JS and Framer.

items.name: drei
items.what: Useful helper components and abstractions for react-three-fiber scenes.

items.name: uikit
items.what: User interface components for react-three-fiber rendered inside 3D scenes.

items.name: react (PlayCanvas)
items.what: Build 3D apps with React using PlayCanvas engine components, with WebGPU support.

items.name: react-native-webgpu
items.what: React Native WebGPU bindings powered by Dawn.

items.name: react-native-effects
items.what: WebGPU-powered shader effects for React Native as drop-in components on a separate thread.

items.name: r3f-webgpu-starter
items.what: React Three Fiber WebGPU starter with post processing and a demo scene.

items.name: liquid-glass-studio
items.what: Recreates Apple's Liquid Glass UI for the web, powered by WebGL2 and WebGPU.

sections.title: Developer Tools, Dashboards and Samples
sections.description: Inspectors, charting, official samples and tutorials for day-to-day WebGPU work.

items.name: webgpu-samples

items.name: ChartGPU

items.name: webgpu_inspector
items.what: Inspection debugger for WebGPU: inspect buffers, textures, pipelines and command streams.

items.name: webgpu-claude-skill
items.what: A Claude skill for developing WebGPU applications with Three.js.

items.name: hello-triangle-webgpu
